investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a plain curl GET of the Anella Olímpica complex's own events-listing page (already proven live for Sant Jordi Club and Palau Sant Jordi — see research/source-investigations/sant-jordi-club-barcelona-01/ and .../palau-sant-jordi-barcelona-01/) yields real, directly-crawlable /en/{slug} links shared across every hall in the complex, including this open-air stadium. A plain curl GET of an individual event detail page's static HTML directly contains its own hall as a literal JS variable ('address').

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the shared listing page and a sampled event detail page directly exposed real, dated, named concert data (The Weeknd, Oques Grasses — 2 real records at proof time, address literally stating 'Estadi Ol\u00edmpic', a JS \u00ed-escaped literal decoded mechanically). No structural/browser escalation was needed.

venue_reference: Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys (open-air stadium, Anella Olímpica complex, Montjuïc, Barcelona)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence — the complex's own official site, and the event page's own literal 'address = "Estadi Ol\u00edmpic"' JS variable (decoded to 'Estadi Olímpic').

site_classification.platform: Same platform already classified for venue-barcelona-sant-jordi-club/venue-barcelona-palau-sant-jordi: static HTML with literal JS variable assignments carrying event facts.

title.notes: Each event page's own <title> tag, up to its first '|' separator.

start_date.notes: Each event page's own literal 'startDate' JS variable, a plain local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' string with no offset — FLOATING_LOCAL, never upgraded to UTC.

time.notes: Embedded in the same 'startDate' value (see start_date).

end.notes: An 'endDate' JS variable is present on some but not all pages sampled for this complex.

venue_location.notes: Each event page's own literal 'address' JS variable, discriminating this hall ('Estadi Olímpic', after decoding its \uXXXX escape) from the other halls sharing the same listing (Sant Jordi Club, Palau Sant Jordi) — only records whose decoded address exactly equals 'Estadi Olímpic' are retained by this source's own collector config.

source_record_id.notes: The event's own permalink slug (the last path segment of its detail-page URL) — a stable, source-native identifier, the same judgement already made for venue-barcelona-sant-jordi-club/venue-barcelona-palau-sant-jordi.

event_url.notes: The event detail page's own URL, directly crawled from the listing page.
